calls.prompt:
Draw one new anatomical exercise illustration: the STANDING STRAIGHT-ARM CABLE PULLDOWN, start position (arms forward at shoulder height).

IMAGE 1 is the canonical athlete. Copy him exactly: the same bald, faceless, muscular anatomical male; white and light-grey skin, crisp muscle separation, fine dark-grey contour lines, soft grey shading; smooth featureless pelvis with no genital detail, no shorts, no underwear, no clothing of any kind; the same plain white trainers. Same proportions, head, hands, feet, limb thickness and line weight. Polished flat 2D anatomical illustration.

IMAGE 2 is a different exercise from the same library. Use it ONLY for the drawing style of the cable machine (dark charcoal-grey steel, grey plates, thin steel cable) and for the violet highlight colour on a pure black background. Do not copy its pose, its rope or its tall tower.

SCENE: pure black background. Nothing under the athlete: no floor line, no mat, no platform, no shadow, no reflection. No text, labels, arrows, numbers or logos. Exactly one person.

CAMERA: side view from the athlete's LEFT, turned a little toward his back (rear three-quarter, about 25 degrees off a pure profile), camera at chest height. The athlete faces RIGHT. Both arms are visible, and the left side of his back with the large latissimus dorsi muscle under the armpit is clearly visible.

EQUIPMENT: a compact dual-pulley cable station stands at the RIGHT side of the picture, close to the athlete, drawn side-on. Its column is partly cut off by the right edge of the image and its top is cut off by the top edge. Two pulleys are mounted high on the column, a little above the athlete's head. Two thin taut steel cables run from the two pulleys diagonally down to two grey D-handles, one D-handle in each of the athlete's hands. Low on the column, a weight stack of identical dark-grey rectangular plates on two guide rods; the top four plates are lifted only a finger's width above the rest. The station is short and simple; it must not dominate the picture.

POSE (start): the athlete stands tall about one long step from the station, feet hip-width apart and flat, knees softly bent, a slight forward lean from the hips (about 10 degrees), braced core, neutral head. BOTH ARMS ARE STRAIGHT AND REACH FORWARD AT SHOULDER HEIGHT toward the station, parallel to the floor, with only a small fixed bend in the elbows. Each hand grips its D-handle; the cables angle up and forward from the hands to the pulleys.

MUSCLE COLOURS: the latissimus dorsi (the broad back and side muscle below the armpit) is filled solid medium violet #7B72E9. The triceps (back of both upper arms) and the abdominals and obliques are filled a lighter lilac #9590E0. Every other muscle stays white-grey. The colour never changes muscle size or hides the contour lines.

FRAMING: square image. The athlete is LARGE: from the top of his head to the soles of his trainers he fills about 88 percent of the image height, with the trainers close to the bottom edge. The athlete, his outstretched arms, the cables and the station fill the frame, with little empty black space. Nothing is cut off the athlete.
calls.outcome: Start position. Arms forward at shoulder height; full station drawn although the prompt asked for it cropped.
